user.title: Configure daily energy comparison
user.description: Select the official daily data, a primary local meter, and optionally a backup meter. Local meters are never added together.

data_description.official_energy_entity: Energy consumed on the latest complete day reported by the distributor.
data_description.official_date_entity: Entity whose state contains the date or timestamp represented by the official value.
data_description.local_energy_entity: Preferred total or total-increasing meter. Its value is used whenever its daily data is healthy.
data_description.primary_local_name: Editable label shown in diagnostics and reports.
data_description.backup_local_energy_entity: Used instead of, never added to, the primary when the primary day is incomplete or frozen.
data_description.backup_local_name: Editable label shown in diagnostics and reports.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure daily energy comparison
reconfigure.description: Change the display name or source entities. Local-meter changes preserve history; official-source changes start a new history.

data_description.official_energy_entity: Energy consumed on the latest complete day reported by the official source.
data_description.official_date_entity: Entity whose state contains the date or timestamp represented by the official value.
data_description.local_energy_entity: Preferred total or total-increasing meter. Swap this with the backup to change priority.
data_description.primary_local_name: Editable label shown in diagnostics and reports.
data_description.backup_local_energy_entity: Optional fallback. Leave empty when only one meter is installed. Values are never summed.
data_description.backup_local_name: Editable label shown in diagnostics and reports.

error.entity_not_found: One or more selected entities do not exist.
error.invalid_date_entity: This entity does not contain a valid date.
error.invalid_energy_entity: This entity does not have a valid Wh, kWh, or MWh energy value.
error.local_must_be_energy: The local entity must have the energy device class.
error.local_must_be_total: The local entity must have the total or total-increasing state class.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name for this comparison.
error.sources_must_differ: The official and local energy sources must be different entities.
error.official_completeness_unavailable: This official sensor does not expose enough information to verify complete days.

sources.title: Local meters
sources.description: Choose, name, include, and optionally calibrate each local meter. Excluding a meter never stops Home Assistant from recording it.

data_description.primary_local_enabled: When disabled, raw data remains recorded but this meter is ignored for comparisons and failover.
data_description.backup_local_enabled: When disabled, raw data remains recorded but this meter is ignored for comparisons and failover.
data_description.primary_calibration_factor: Multiplies only the value used for coherence. The raw value remains visible and stored.
data_description.backup_calibration_factor: Multiplies only the value used for coherence. The raw value remains visible and stored.

thresholds.title: Comparison and health thresholds
thresholds.description: Critical status is deliberately conservative and requires repeated complete days.

error.critical_must_exceed_green: The critical threshold must be greater than the green tolerance.
